t: Makers of Morocco: finding local crafts and creators in Fez – Lonely Planet - Lonely Planet
s: January 14, 2025 - Don’t miss one of the iconic sights (and smells) of the Fez medina: the medieval Chaouwara Tanneries, where you can look down on stone vats filled with vibrant dyes spread out like a painter’s palette, as animal hides are stripped, treated, dyed and dried in a process that’s barely changed since the 11th century. The surrounding shops sell all-things leather, from pouffes to slippers, bags to butter-soft jackets – you can get one made to order in 24 hours. Bargaining is expected, but only start haggling if you’re serious about buying.
